title: Subsumed allomorph forms
description: This check finds an entry whose allomorphs repeat the same morph type and forms with different environment lists, where one copy's conditions are already covered by another: one copy has no environment, one list is a subset of the other, or both list the same environments in another order. Copies with disjoint or partly overlapping lists are not reported, because different environments for one form are a legitimate disjunction. Copies with identical environment lists belong to the repeated-forms check, and allomorphs without forms are skipped.
